contexts.text: That the Word was closed up. Signified.

The Word is said to be closed up when it is understood only as to the sense of the letter, and everything therein is taken for doctrine; and it is still more closed up, when those things which favour the cupidities of the love of self and of the world are acknowledged as doctrinal things.
What it is for the Word to be closed up, may be very evident from the Jews... who are of such a character as to utterly close up the Word as to interior things.
That meanwhile it was closed up. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as this is done, the Word is closed up.
So closed up are their minds...
In the same proportion he closes up the Rational... AC 5128:2. AC 5128:3.
Hence the influx of good withdraws itself, and so the internal through which the influx comes is closed; and through this closing up there results stupidity in spiritual things...
This closing up penetrates towards the exteriors more and more, according to the life of evil, and thence the persuasion of falsity...
The Hells are therefore kept tightly closed up by the Lord.
Genii would also enter into the hereditary evils of the old will... which yet are closed up. References.
As soon as truths separated from good want to enter, Heaven, thus the way to the Lord, is closed up.
When (the Israelites) were in what is holy, their interiors were closed up... It would have been quite different if internal things had not been closed up with them... AC 9962:end.
With those who are in corporeal and earthly loves the interiors are closed up; and those with whom the interiors are closed up do not acknowledge anything internal...
That into which Heaven should operate is not present, because it is closed up...
Closing up as to the influx of good and truth, and of things in affinity with them, lest there be any reception and communication. Signified.
To kill = to take away spiritual life... here, therefore, to close up...
The closing up of what is internal with that nation. Signified, Explained. AC 10492:2.
The plenary closing up of what is internal. Signified.

Evils and falsities are what close up the internal man; or, what is the same, worldly, earthly, and corporeal love do so when they reign... The reason the internal man is closed up by them, is that these loves are opposite to heavenly loves...
To prevent this (profanation), the internal man with (the Israelites) was plenarily closed up. That it was plenarily closed up, is very manifest from this...

Two things were requisite; one, that the internal with them should be completely closed up... For when the internal is completely closed up, the internal of the Church and of worship is neither denied nor acknowledged...
What is negative not only closes up the internal...
The closing up of the internal... of the Church, of worship, and of the Word, which is over their external. Signified.
When there is no internal, that is, when it is closed up, there is communication with Hell.
Therefore internal things were closed up against them. Signified.
All who do this see nothing from Heaven; their internal, which should be open into Heaven, is closed up...
By blind faith they have closed up their eyes.
The spiritual degree not open, but still not closed up. Explained.
The lot of those with whom the spiritual degree is not open, but still is not closed up...
The character of the natural man with whom the spiritual degree is completely closed up. Explained.

This degree is contracted, and by contraction closed up, with those especially... who are in the love of dominion from self-love... It is also closed up in those who, from the love of the world, are in the insane cupidity of possessing the goods of others; but not to so great an extent.

The contraction or closing up of this degree is like the retorsion of a spiral into the opposite; which is the reason why, after this degree has been closed up, it turns back the light of Heaven... DLW 263:2.
With these men not only is this degree itself closed up, but also the higher region of the natura degree, which is called the Rational.

From this it is evident, that if the spiritual mind is closed up, the natural mind continually acts against those things which are of the spiritual mind... From which it follows, that when the spiritual mind is closed up, the natural mind reacts against all things of Heaven...
When a man is such, he successively closes up the spiritual mind closer and closer. Confirmations of evil by falsities especially close it up.
Hence confirmations of evil and falsity are closings up of Heaven...
The malignity of evil increases according to the degree of the closing up of the spiritual mind; for thus the natural mind also is closed above.
The understanding, being closed up in Divine things, from religion, could advance no further.
Everything above the Rational was closed up with this confirmer; and only that which is below the Rational was open.
All these places in Hell are roofed over and closed up...
As soon as any Christian without a really serious reason adjoins a concubine to a wife, Heaven is closed up against him...
After Heaven has been closed up he becomes a spiritual insanity.
Heaven is closed up against adulterers, and Hell is open.
As soon as a man actually becomes an adulterer, Heaven is closed up against him; on the closing up of which, God is not acknowledged...
In spiritual light their understanding appeared open below, but closed up above. Why.
They close up the higher things of the mind against God, and open the lower things to the devil...

The man who by a denial of God has excommunicated himself from the Church, and thus from Heaven, has closed up the internal man as to the will... But he cannot close up his internal man as to the understanding...

If he then closes up the highest natural degree, which corresponds to the highest celestial one, he becomes as to love like a beast of the earth; but if he closes up the middle natural degree, which corresponds to the middle spiritual one, he becomes as to love like a fox, and as to the sight of the understanding like a bird of evening; but if he also closes up the ultimate natural degree as to its Spiritual, he becomes as to love like a wild beast, and as to the understanding of truth like a fish. TCR 40:2.

If this degree as to its Spiritual is completely closed up, which takes place when God is denied, and Satan is worshipped, the reception of life from God may be compared to the influx of light into opaque things...
The life of evil and the faith of falsity thence has closed up the interiors of your minds...
A closed up or blind faith... TCR 346:2.
The higher region of the mind is then closed up...
Falsities close up the understanding, and truths open it.
He hath closed your eyes () = no understanding of truth. AE 376:32. AE 577:7.
The perception of good is closed up by a life of evil... and the understanding of truth is closed up by principles of falsity...
To shut up () = to be deprived.
